evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Deliberate contrast within one frame: an unrehearsed rollback opposed to a rollback one does not have — matched structure ('A rollback… is a rollback…') crystallizing a rule into opposed clauses.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
